title: QCrypton PQC Scanner
descriptionMarkdown:
The **QCrypton PQC Scanner** connector ingests post-quantum cryptography readiness findings from your Azure environment into Microsoft Sentinel. Findings include Key Vault key posture (RSA/ECC vs. PQ-hybrid), TLS certificate signature algorithms on public endpoints, Storage Account and App Service TLS configuration, and CMK provenance.

The scanner container pushes findings to the `PQReadiness_CL` custom table via a Data Collection Rule (DCR). This solution automatically provisions the DCE, DCR, and custom table.

sampleQueries.description: All quantum-vulnerable findings in the last 24h
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceName, AssetKind, Algorithm, PostureReason, RiskScore
| order by RiskScore desc

sampleQueries.description: Vulnerable Key Vault keys grouped by subscription
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where AssetKind == 'kv-key' and QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| summarize count() by SubscriptionId, Algorithm

sampleQueries.description: TLS certs expiring after 2030 still using classical signatures
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where AssetKind in ('tls-cert', 'kv-cert') and QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| where ExpiresOn > datetime(2030-01-01)
| project ResourceName, AssetIdentifier, SignatureAlgorithm, ExpiresOn, RiskScore

value:
PQReadiness_CL
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(7d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and write permissions on the Log Analytics workspace

customs.name: Azure subscription with reader access
customs.description: The QCrypton PQC Scanner container-app identity requires **Reader** on the target subscription(s), **Key Vault Reader** on the vaults to be scanned, and **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** on the Data Collection Rule.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Ingestion pipeline provisioned
instructionSteps.description: This solution automatically deployed a **Data Collection Endpoint (DCE)**, **Data Collection Rule (DCR)**, and the **PQReadiness_CL** custom table. Find the DCE Endpoint and DCR Immutable ID under **Monitor > Data Collection Rules** in the Azure Portal, or from the solution deployment outputs.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Deploy the QCrypton PQC Scanner container
instructionSteps.description:
Install the scanner from [Azure Marketplace](https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/marketplace/apps/qcryptoninc1788706847984.qcrypton-pqc-scanner) or deploy `deploy/containerapp.bicep`. Set these environment variables on the container:

- `DCE_ENDPOINT` -- Data Collection Endpoint URI
- `DCR_IMMUTABLE_ID` -- Data Collection Rule Immutable ID

instructionSteps.title: 3. Assign permissions
instructionSteps.description:
Grant the container app managed identity:

- **Reader** at subscription scope
- **Key Vault Reader** on target vaults
- **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** on the Data Collection Rule
